How Excel changed her life, and the two Excel tattoos
Is Excel dead? Answering the critics

Copilot, AI and the end of coding barriers
Excel and Power BI as partners
Teaching, community and becoming an MVP

takeaways: Karen Abecia built a global career as an Excel educator without a university degree, driven by continuous learning and a focus on visual, well-presented spreadsheets.
In her view, great dashboards come from small details such as alignment, consistent colors and correct text, not just numbers and charts, and Excel and Power BI complement each other.
She is still building her working relationship with Copilot in Excel, and she sees the Microsoft MVP award as recognition for years of helping people with data.
hook: Many professionals use Excel every day without realizing how far it can take their careers. In this interview, Microsoft MVP Karen Abecia tells Excel users, data enthusiasts and educators how spreadsheets, dashboards and AI tools like Copilot shaped her journey and what makes data presentation truly stand out.
